source_policy: 6连环飞舞提高连打率、弓流星三矢连射3箭、格斗夺命连环在连击武功追加30%、刺连消带打回避后下次普攻附对方伤害的职责取源。以下概率/间隔/快照/上限/触发限制为项目采用。

normal_extra_hit.eligible_root: normal attack with first actual hostile HP damage to original living primary; once per root action
normal_extra_hit.success: queue exactly1derived hit at6world steps to same primary
normal_extra_hit.damage_snapshot: same accepted action attack interval, derived ordinal own uniform attack draw/accuracy but crit explicitly disabled
normal_extra_hit.geometry_recheck: original range/LOS/shape at derived event; no teleport/retarget/follow target beyond range

normal_three_arrows.eligible_root: normal bow attack first actual hostile HP hit to original living primary; once per root
normal_three_arrows.success: root initial arrow plus2derived actual projectiles, launched6and12steps after qualifying primary hit
normal_three_arrows.projectile_policy: snapshot original normal bow speed/radius/max life; face original target last validated direction at launch; collision may intercept but never changes root primary for proc purposes
normal_three_arrows.per_arrow: independent accuracy, inclusive interval draw, no crit; no arrows if attacker dead/weapon incompatible; no wall ignoring impact

combo_skill_extra_damage.eligible_root: attack martial skill explicitly declared combo hit ordinals>=2, first actual primary HP damage once; not all skills guessed from names
combo_skill_extra_damage.success: same primary receives floor(trigger actualHP loss30percent) once; ordinary defense/crit not applied again, status protection applies once
combo_skill_extra_damage.shared_family_owner: 枪格斗狂风与破甲气功.v1.json combo_extra30;同root会心/夺命 only strongesteligiblechance+stableID once, no2separate30percenthits

evade_next_normal_bonus.trigger: source directly targeted hostile normal/martial attack fails23accuracy; target alive with positive effective skill; iframe/LOS/range/friendly/immune rejection not counted as successful evasion
evade_next_normal_bonus.saved_bonus: source accepted raw attack interval maximum+its explicit phase flat power, multiplied phase coefficient without accuracy/crit/targetdefense; no new random draw to estimate missed damage
evade_next_normal_bonus.maximum_bonus: current defender attack maximum*2; finite checked before math, lower cap is explicit gameplay
evade_next_normal_bonus.storage: one armed next-normal token per defender, replace by stronger snapshot not add, remaining180steps; weak event refreshes remaining only if it replaces token by equal/higher amount
evade_next_normal_bonus.consume: on next accepted normal attack, add to its first primary-target hit input once before mitigation; consume at accept, miss/cancel/no target does not refund; not to every3combo stage
evade_next_normal_bonus.zero_effective_grade: token inactive but preserved remaining time until expiry; wash/death clears, temporary anti debuff does not refund permanent points

derived_event_policy: every extra hit/arrow/30percent add has root_event_id+derived_ordinal and tag derived_no_attack_procs. No additional combo,offensive rage,bleed,charge,anti,致残 or recoil recursion. Ordinary valid derived damage still credited once and can supply defender base received-rage; explicit learned defensive callbacks follow nonrecursive guard. No gather/material/skill-resource generation.
one_action_source_policy: if multiple explicit same-family combo passives legally present, strongest family chance applied once, never independent extra-chain loops. Each named class-owned skill requires learned/allocated positive effective grade.
persistence: queue launch/due steps, root/primary,source attack snapshot,remaining projectile life,per-derived receipts and armed evade token kept in full activity snapshots; pause/offline freeze. Ordinary action save waits root and all descendants end, not only animation recovery; no saved paid action with missing delayed damage.
defensive_recursion: derived events cannot arm连消带打 or new offensive procs; defensive damage reduction/heal can run only by explicit eligible direct-hit tags, never inferred as a new player action.
